content: Yɛsu kan'bel alɔŋki ande bàtàtwɛb
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl tsütsü a ɛwà a Ngɛnàsàlɛr, baar mbɔɔn bàkyer un'diŋà ntɔn muwem ndaa a Nzam.
Nde kàmɛn an'bwaar an'mɔ̈ɔ̈l mà ipɔl kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà ntɔn aŋama bàkäl musɔŋ an'kwen aba.
Nde kàlär uboo a bwaar làmwɛy, la làkäl là Simɔn, waa kun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa nde usiinà la ikyee uboo a an'dà. Nde waa kàbwaay, kàlɔɔŋà baar uboo a bwaar.
Mpal kàmay nde mulɔŋ, nde kàtɛn a Simɔn naa: « Làkyen uboboo a an'dà, làtɔɔm an'kwen abɛ kan'dà ntɔn mulwab nsö. »
Simɔn kun'fuur naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kan'kyer mpib aŋun'kiinà, wɛɛ bi akà undiir imɛn anki. Ntɔn ngye aman'swaŋ, mɛ in'kyer atɔɔm an'kwen. »
Ungö mutɔɔm ma, ba bàsiim nsö mbɔɔn, an'kwen màkäl tsütsü mukaamà.
Ba bàbel atɔŋ aba bàkäl uboo a bwaar lumwɛy ntɔn ba babay. Ba waa bàyi, bàyööl an'bwaar màmɔ̈ɔ̈l: ma màkäl tsütsü muminà ntɔn buur a nsö.
Mpal kàmɛn Simɔn abun, nde kàbü kà in'kɔl a Yɛsu, waa kàtɛn naa: « Mwol, lwomà tsütsü apà mɛ, ntɔn mɛ in'wà mbuur a man'be. »
Ntɔn nde anà atɔŋ ande matɛɛr màkyer awal ntɔn bàsiim ba nsö mbɔɔn.
Atɔŋ ande Zyak anà Ywan, baan a Zebàday, bàkäl sye asànaa nde. Apan, Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a Simɔn naa: « Twon an'man bɔɔmà, sɛmà apanà ngye an'bulà un'lɔ̈ɔ̈b a baar. »
Ungö bàmay ba mutwey an'bwaar u nkankyel, ba bàsàwɛy ma, waa bàläb Yɛsu.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr ŋun'kyal a bay
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkäl u bul mwɛy, ŋun'kyal a bay kun'mɛn nde, nde kàbü kusà ande, waa kun'bɔ̈ɔ̈n naa: « Mwol, kya ngye asàkwen, mpööŋ. »
Yɛsu kàsilà kɔɔ ande, waa kun'bä, waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ an'kwen, pɔŋà! » Taaŋ nsil alan bay waa làlwomà.
Ungö apan nde kun'tsüŋ naa: « Twon an'kyään mbuur asin ndaa ayi. Wɛɛ, kyen akà ngaŋ ntɔn nde kaler, ungö waa ngye apà an'kab kàswɛŋ Mɔsɛ ntɔn mpööŋà angye, waa kya ikal imbäl ntɔn ba. »
Apan, làkoo ande làkyer apää ntsü yanswà, baar mbɔɔn bàyee ntɔn muwem ndaa ande anà muleŋ nkɔɔr unsà an'kyal aba.
Wɛɛ nde kàkyeenà kà ikal a mpey ntɔn mukàyamà Nzam.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr mbuur aŋàkwɛkà

Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl mulɔŋ. Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkäl paa sye ban'bwaay. Ba bàfü an'bul manswà mà Ngalilɛ, mà Yuday anà Yɛlusàlɛm. Ngwal a Mwol yàkäl a Yɛsu ntɔn mukɔɔr abɛy.
Apan sye, baar amwɛy bàtwäl mbuur mwɛy aŋàkwɛkà udu a ipɔy. Ba bàleŋà mukun'biil uboo a ndwà anà bun'tɔɔl kusà a Yɛsu.
Abà bàmɛn ba naa mbwo abilà yatɛy ntɔn baar bàkäl mbɔɔn, ba bàpfuul mun u mpaan a ndwà, waa bun'tɔɔl kusà a Yɛsu u mii a baar banswà.
Mpal kàmɛn nde làkwikilà aba, Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Mbuur wà, mɛ amadwääl nkul a man'be angye. »
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn waa bàyweerà u mpem aba naa: « Nà mbuur awà? Nde wàmubɛy Nzam. Nà kan'kwo mudwa nkul a man'be isàkal naa kà Nzam anki? »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàyöb nde ankyän aba, waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « An'kyän nà bɛ làwe amà u mpem abɛ?
Undiir nà akɔ̈ɔ̈n mpay mutɛn: Bàmadwääl nkul angye, lɛɛ mutɛn naa: Mbarà, kyen?
Apanà, yubwaŋ bɛ làyöb naa Mwan a mbuur we anà ikɔ̈b mudwääl baar nkul a man'be aba u mɛɛn pà. » Nde kàswɛŋ mbuur aŋàkwɛkà naa: « Mɛ amaswaŋ, mbarà, sɛn ipɔy angye, furà ndwà angye. »
Taaŋ nsil alan, u mii a baar banswà, laa kàmbarà nde, kàsɛn nde ipɔy ande, waa kàfurà ndwà ande wàmuyisà Nzam làkoo.
Baar banswà bàkäl mubem, waa bàsyäŋà Nzam. Unsà bɔɔmà ba bàtɛɛnà naa: « Bi kan'man indiir ibaŋ ŋàbawà. »
Yɛsu kan'bel Lɛvi
Ungö apan Yɛsu kàtoo nde, nde kàmɛn un'füür a itɛr mwɛy ikɔb ande Lɛvi kan'bwaay kà ikal a isal ande. Nde kàtɛn a nde naa: « Yan'läb. »
Nde sye laa kàsàwɛy nde indiir byanswà, waa kun'läb.
Lɛvi kàwɛl Yɛsu unsà ubwaŋ banswà u ndwà ande. Afüür a itɛr mbɔɔn anà baar asin bàkäl mudyà anà nde u mɛsà.
Amfarisi anà alɔɔŋ a Un'kɔɔn bàkyer aŋüŋün, waa bàtɛn a alɔŋki a Yɛsu naa: « Ntɔn nkye làkadyaa bɛ ikal imwɛy anà afüür a itɛr anà baar a man'be? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Kà baar abye anà ngwal u ndür anki bye anà mfun a un'ngaŋ, wɛɛ aŋukyal.
Mɛ kàyi anki muleŋ mbuul a mpem a baar a balàbal, wɛɛ mbuul a mpem a baar a man'be. »
Yɛsu anà nkin a mbɔr
Amfarisi bàtɛn ande naa: « Alɔŋki a Ywan anà alɔŋki abi bàfàkin mbɔr mbalà mbɔɔn anà muyamà Nzam, wɛ alɔŋki angye isal aba udyà anà unwà. »
Nde kafuur naa: « Nkye asam a mbuur kan'tà bɔr ban'kwo bàkin mbɔr isàkal naa nde wà paa anà ba?
Ilä kyà paa bàsàlwom ba un'tɛɛl a bɔr, apan ba waa bàsàkin mbɔr. »
Nde kàfatɛɛl nsim yi: « Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki muwal itɛɛnà a ipfɛy akün ntɔn mubaay ipfɛy aŋànün. Ntɔn itɛɛnà akin iyàpà anki ubwaŋ unsà ipfɛy aŋànün.
Akà mbuur mwɛy sye ukwe anki musà man akün uboo a mbeen itaan: naa tɛy, man akün iyàpfuul mbeen itaan, waa ipää, mbeen sye waa ikyà bwà.
Yubwaŋ musà man akün u mbeen akün.
Akà mbuur mwɛy ukwe anki mukwen man akün isàkal naa nde akyàfuràtànwà man itaan, ntɔn nde ayàtɛn naa: "Man a itaan mà ntsà." »
